schema.description:
Mail domain — the unit of DNS ownership for inbound (Email Routing
CNAMEs + MX) and outbound (DKIM, SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT) email.
Mirrors the `mail_domains` row shape after `services/api/migrations/
0007_mta_sts.sql`. The Phase C MTA-STS + TLS-RPT fields drive
self-hosted policy publishing under `mta-sts.{domain}`; see
`_mta_sts_mode` for the lifecycle states.

mta_sts_mode.description:
Lifecycle state for self-hosted MTA-STS:
  - `none` — no policy published; senders fall back to opportunistic TLS.
  - `testing` — policy published with `mode: testing`; senders honour MX hosts
    but do NOT enforce on failure (TLS-RPT reports record violations).
  - `enforce` — policy published with `mode: enforce`; senders refuse delivery
    on policy failure.

mta_sts_policy_id.description:
Opaque ULID/hash advertised as `id=` in the `_mta-sts.{domain}` TXT
record and embedded in the served policy file. Rotated on every
policy publish so MTA-STS-aware senders refresh their cached copy.

mta_sts_max_age.description:
`max_age` (seconds) emitted in the served policy file (RFC 8461 §3.2).
Default 86400 (1 day). Operators may raise this once policy is
stable to extend sender-side caching.

tlsrpt_enabled.description:
Whether the `_smtp._tls.{domain}` TXT record is published. Stored
as INTEGER 0/1 to match the existing `inbound_enabled` /
`outbound_enabled` pattern; PATCH accepts a boolean.

schema.title: MailDomain
